ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, place a right-angled triangle plate as indicated, keeping \(AB \parallel DE\). What is the degree measure of \(\angle ACD\)?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} From the given, we have: $\angle A= 30^\circ$, $\angle D= 45^\circ$,\\
As shown in the figure, let AB intersect CD at point F,\\
Since AB$\parallel$DE,\\
Therefore, $\angle AFD=\angle D= 45^\circ$,\\
Since $\angle AFD$ is an exterior angle of $\triangle ACF$,\\
Therefore, $\angle ACD=\angle AFD-\angle A = \boxed{15^\circ}$.
